change_log.what: pass-5 repairs I1/I2/I3 land entirely in scripts/hgk-lane-dispatch.py + tests/test_lane_dispatch_ao_guard.py; this candidate artifact carries NO structural change and its ordered_pool entries are unchanged
fields_added_to_the_receipt: usage_rows_shape_invalid -- count of appended usage rows whose JSON shape was not an object (a nonempty array / bare true / string / integer is now SKIPPED and COUNTED, never a crash and never a receipt)
usage_ledger_rewritten -- now also true when the ledger GREW but its pre-turn bytes [0:offset) are no longer byte-identical (content-based prefix digest, not a size comparison)
change_log.i3_precedence: the frozen oracle's C1 classification (ERR_NO_ARM_EMITTED_NONCE + nonce_absent_arms) takes precedence whenever an arm answered with exit 0 and a valid usage receipt
change_log.why: a fourth independent VERIFY/SECURITY review of the PASS-4 bytes returned FAIL: the pass-4 shrinking-only ledger check missed a GROWING rewrite; a wrong-shaped usage row crashed the row parser with no receipt; and an invalid carrier overwrote a valid usage measurement and pre-empted the oracle's C1 classification

change_log.what: pass-6 class-level repairs J1/J2/J3/J4 land entirely in scripts/hgk-lane-dispatch.py + tests/test_lane_dispatch_ao_guard.py; this candidate artifact carries NO structural change and its ordered_pool entries are unchanged
fields_added_to_the_receipt: usage_rows_undecodable -- count of appended ledger lines that FAILED strict UTF-8 decoding and were skipped (J1); such a line is never substituted with U+FFFD and never compared
carrier_shape_invalid_detail -- a per-attempt diagnostic string (J4); the carrier-shape condition is a DETAIL, not a top-level code
change_log.j4_precedence_table: TOP-LEVEL codes are derivable ONLY from the frozen requirement's table: (1) some arm produced an ACCEPTABLE turn (exit 0 + a valid usage receipt) and no arm emitted the nonce => ERR_NO_ARM_EMITTED_NONCE + nonce_absent_arms; (2) NO arm produced an acceptable turn (timeouts, errors, invalid usage, malformed evidence, rewritten ledger, undecodable line) => the generic ERR_LANE_ALL_ROUTES_EXHAUSTED (with timed_out_arms measured when every attempt timed out). ERR_CARRIER_SHAPE_INVALID and ERR_USAGE_LEDGER_REWRITTEN are NO LONGER top-level codes: they are per-attempt detail fields (carrier_shape_invalid / carrier_shape_invalid_detail / usage_ledger_rewritten / usage_receipt_reason).
change_log.typing_rule: exact types and values only (J3): a str field equals only a str -- a JSON integer 7 is not the string "7"; no str()/int()/bool()/float() coercion ever decides a match
change_log.line_rule: only COMPLETE, line-boundary-anchored lines are evidence (J2): the region is [offset, last newline]; a non-line-boundary offset (byte at offset-1 is not a newline) yields ZERO rows, and an unterminated tail is never a row
change_log.why: a fifth independent VERIFY/SECURITY review returned FAIL: five instance-by-instance passes did not close the class of lossy-decodes / coerced types / loose comparisons / partial reads. Pass 6 closes the class by construction: strict UTF-8 decode everywhere, only line-complete evidence, exact typing (no coercion), and a single requirement-owned top-level code precedence table with diagnostics demoted to details

change_log.what: pass-2 repairs T1/T2/T3 land entirely in scripts/hgk-lane-dispatch.py, src/hg_kseos/lane_route_resolver.py + tests/test_lane_dispatch_ao_guard.py; this candidate artifact carries NO structural change and its ordered_pool entries are unchanged
fields_added_to_the_receipt: carrier_lines_surrogate -- count of carrier texts SKIPPED for carrying a surrogate code point (U+D800-U+DFFF), e.g. an escaped \ud800; such text never decides a verdict
change_log.t1_line_rule: the line's bytes are the bytes between the terminators (T1): the ONLY removal is at most ONE trailing CR (so CRLF still parses). The previous unrestricted pre-cleaning strip is gone; a leading NEL (U+0085), a trailing U+2028, a trailing vertical tab (U+000B) or any other non-JSON-whitespace character reaches the parser and makes it fail. JSON's own insignificant whitespace (space/tab/LF/CR) is left to the parser
change_log.t2_strict_parse: every parsed value that can decide a verdict (carrier lines, usage rows, the pool artifact, the auth/relay credential documents) goes through one strict JSON parse with a raising parse_constant, so the non-JSON constants NaN / Infinity / -Infinity RAISE and are never accepted as a permissive float
change_log.t3_surrogate_rule: text containing a surrogate code point (U+D800-U+DFFF) never decides a nonce or a shape judgement: it is skipped and counted, so a surrogate can never be searched as if it were the arm's message
change_log.why: the pass-1 independent review constructed five further carrier shapes (trailing U+2028 / leading NEL / trailing U+000B / escaped lone surrogate \ud800 / non-JSON NaN) that still reported success: an unrestricted strip deleted real characters before the parser saw them, a surrogate was searched after decoding, and json.loads accepted NaN by default. Pass 2 closes those three mechanisms and sweeps the reader for any remaining lossy decode, permissive default, substituted character, invented boundary, partial read or pre-clean that could decide a verdict

classes.relay_pool: the arm consumes the relay's ChatGPT subscription credential; not refreshable => ERR_RELAY_OAUTH_NEEDS_REAUTH, refused BEFORE spawn

identity_requirements_declared.measured_basis: an arm routed with `-c openai_base_url=<relay>` consumes the RELAY's credential, NOT the lane home's CLI login - so `codex login status` = Not logged in in the lane home is NOT a reason to refuse the openai arm (this corrects an earlier draft of the fix, which proposed seeding the lane home).
identity_requirements_declared.health_rule: an expired ACCESS token is normal (the relay refreshes single-flight); only the absence of REFRESH material is a failure. The gate therefore checks refreshability, not expiry.
identity_requirements_declared.gate_scope: CODEX-CLI lanes only (EXECUTE / VERIFY_SECURITY). The PLAN lane runs on the hermes engine and is not dispatched by scripts/hgk-lane-dispatch.py.
identity_requirements_declared.implementation: scripts/hgk-lane-dispatch.py: default_identity_requirement() + identity_check() + the pre-spawn gate in main(); tests/test_lane_dispatch_ao_guard.py
identity_requirements_declared.require_arm_semantics: --require-arm provider/model makes the run FAIL CLOSED instead of silently degrading to another arm when the named arm is refused

transport_vocabulary.rule: the transport id is per-provider: openai-codex REQUIRES the bare id; nvidia REQUIRES '<provider>/<model>'; opencode-go accepts bare or qualified.
